notable_absence.finding: As with the other data-plane statements/clauses in this batch, no management-plane capella-role gate appears here - only the credential-type/privilege pair - consistent with round 2's finding that requiresCapellaRole is reserved for a different (management-plane) surface.

cross_component_finding: The Advanced-credential privilege for NEST's read access is named 'Query Read' here, but merge.md's Advanced-credential privilege for the structurally equivalent read access to its source keyspace is named 'Query Select' - both are 'read the keyspace for a join/merge source' operations, yet the docs use two different privilege names for what may be the same underlying permission. This may be a genuine two-privilege distinction (e.g. Query Select for SELECT-clause projection vs. Query Read for join/nest access) or simply inconsistent terminology across pages; flagging for reconciliation rather than assuming they're identical or minting a merge relation between them without evidence.
cross_product_finding: Recurrence of docs-issues/capella-pages-cite-server-versions.json: the LATERAL keyword note reads 'In clusters using Couchbase Server 7.6 and later, you can use the LATERAL keyword as a visual reminder...' - a literal server version citation on a Capella clause page.
